items.coverage: Decomposition/equilibrium/exchange schemes and proposed stabilization mechanism; interpretation task only. No extra chemical reaction procedure inferred.
Reported PBE-D3/CP2K structures, surface terminations, adsorption energies and Born-Oppenheimer dynamics are explicitly nonmanual. No code installed or calculation executed.
ShelXT/Olex2/ShelXL solution/refinement and crystallographic tables are analytical outputs from SCXRD, not extra robot motion. No new structure solved.
Fits, phi-weighted mobility and diffusion length require units, calibration, temperature and explicit substrate-transfer assumptions; no paper numbers injected as observations.
Apparent kinetic fits and percentage decomposition from NMR series are separate derived records; Q10 unit issue retained.
Selected diffraction-peak integrated-intensity ratios are reported analysis; not automatically absolute calibrated phase mass fractions.
External certification and literature comparison table are evidence-only. Mock custody task cannot issue a genuine certificate.
Distribution/mean/uncertainty analysis requires genuinely separate mock specimens and declared sample count. Published values are source results, not reward targets.

boundary: Interpretations and analyses are represented for paper coverage, not falsely inflated into hands-on tasks.
